entries.300c2c936be6c2c8: This is a service business and other businesses not included in reportable segments. Bridgestone Singapore Pte. Ltd. in Singapore trades natural rubber, and Bridgestone Treasury Singapore Pte. Ltd. makes loans and purchases receivables. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥18,045 million (¥19,475 million in the previous year), and the number of employees was 7,630.
entries.30f2141dfcbf18fa: This is the business in Asia, Oceania, India and China. Bridgestone Asia Pacific Pte. Ltd. in Singapore and Bridgestone (China) Investment Co., Ltd. in China oversee and sell, while Bridgestone (Tianjin) Tire Co., Ltd. and Bridgestone (Wuxi) Tire Co., Ltd. in China, Bridgestone India Private Ltd. in India, Thai Bridgestone Co., Ltd. and Bridgestone Tire Manufacturing (Thailand) Co., Ltd. in Thailand, and PT Bridgestone Tire Indonesia in Indonesia make and sell automobile tires. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥478,733 million (¥478,690 million in the previous year), and the number of employees was 18,425. The company states that unit sales of truck and bus tires fell significantly below the previous year, while replacement passenger car and light truck tires were firm, and revenue slightly exceeded the previous year.
entries.59b10dee3d8c670a: This is a business in North and South America, including the United States, Canada, Mexico and Brazil. Under the supervising company Bridgestone Americas, Inc., Bridgestone Americas Tire Operations, LLC (United States), Bridgestone Canada Inc., Bridgestone de Mexico, S.A. DE C.V. and Bridgestone do Brasil Industria e Comercio LTDA. produce and sell automobile tires, and Bridgestone Retail Operations, LLC handles tire sales, automobile maintenance and repair, and the sale of supplies. Firestone Polymers, LLC makes a tire raw material (synthetic rubber), and Firestone Industrial Products Company, LLC makes air springs. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥2,107,190 million (¥2,157,097 million in the previous year); it is the largest of the 5 segments, and the number of employees is 46,312. Revenue from sales to the United States, based on the location of the destination of sales, was ¥1,843,920 million. Revenue of Bridgestone Americas Tire Operations, LLC was ¥1,169,521 million and that of Bridgestone Retail Operations, LLC was ¥764,009 million; both exceed 10% of consolidated revenue after excluding internal revenue among consolidated companies, so their amounts are shown individually. The company states that in North America, unit sales of replacement passenger car and light truck tires were in line with the previous year and replacement truck and bus tires were firm, while tires for new vehicles fell below the previous year; in South America, unit sales of passenger car, light truck, and truck and bus tires fell significantly; and revenue in the Americas decreased from the previous year.
entries.6edd06c9cb09c3fe: This is the business in Japan. BRIDGESTONE CORPORATION itself supervises, manufactures and sells, and Bridgestone Tire Solutions Japan Co., Ltd. oversees the sale of domestic replacement tires. Bridgestone Chemical Products Japan Co., Ltd. sells and installs industrial rubber products and building materials, Bridgestone Sports Co., Ltd. makes and sells golf equipment, and Bridgestone Cycle Co., Ltd. makes and sells bicycles. Bridgestone Specialty Tire Manufacturing (Thailand) Co., Ltd. in Thailand (construction and mining vehicle tires and aircraft tires) and Bridgestone Mining Solutions Australia Pty. Ltd. in Australia (sales of construction and mining vehicle tires and related services) are also included in this Japan segment. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥993,635 million (¥961,777 million in the previous year), the 2nd largest after the Americas. In addition, internal revenue between segments was ¥272,216 million. The number of employees is 24,563, which includes employees at Japanese tire plants that make tires for other segments. Revenue from sales with a destination in Japan was ¥620,385 million. The company states that unit sales of replacement passenger car and light truck tires and of truck and bus tires performed well, while unit sales of tires for new-vehicle passenger cars and light trucks fell below the previous year; revenue in Japan increased from the previous year.

entries.c43507ad67412617: This is the business in Europe, the Middle East and Africa. Bridgestone Europe NV/SA in Belgium oversees and sells the business within the region, and Bridgestone Poznan Sp. z o.o., Bridgestone Stargard Sp. z o.o. in Poland, Bridgestone Tatabanya Kft. in Hungary and Bridgestone Hispania Manufacturing, S.L.U. in Spain make automobile tires. Bridgestone Middle East & Africa FZE in the United Arab Emirates sells tires for the Middle East and Africa. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥831,840 million (¥813,048 million in the previous year), and the number of employees was 15,783. The company states that unit sales of replacement passenger car and light truck tires performed well, while unit sales of tires for new-vehicle passenger cars and light trucks and of truck and bus tires fell below the previous year; revenue in Europe, the Middle East and Africa increased from the previous year.
